title.narrative: Support to Strengthen Strategic Communication Capacity and Resilience Against Disinformation, Foreign Information Manipulation and Interference in the Republic of Moldova

description.narrative:
The months leading up to the Parliamentary elections in autumn 2025 will be of the crucial importance in Moldova in terms of targeted strategic communication activities. This is a period which represents a critical window of opportunity to enhance the resilience of Moldovan society against malign information activities and external interference. The proposed actions under this project aim to find ways to urgently empower the informational resilience and capacity for issue-based cooperation of state structures, experts, communities and society, particularly in the regions, for preparing for the challenges posed by potential information interference and undermining disorders via malign information attacks.


It is extremely important for Moldova's strategic communication partners to have skills and capacity to focus on efforts which react to the malicious attacks in information space via raising awareness about disinformation and building capacity for monitoring information disorders. Equally critical is to build up resilience-building efforts which emphasise conscious nation-building and societal cohesion. From the strategic communication point of view, it is crucial to raise the level of national self-confidence and psychological defence to protect the society facing active malign information activities and continuous attempts at dividing and undermining the society.
